This year's hurricane season has been unusually quiet, and a new study suggests this might become the norm. According to researchers at Princeton, the warmer the climate gets, the fewer tropical cyclones form. But fewer doesn't necessarily mean better. Let's take a look.

Paper: https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.16521
